<translate>
The '''Cell Arena''' (the Cell Games Arena) is [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]]'s ring in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Cell trains only Evil-aligned players, and hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]] here.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]]''' covers a huge part of the skill and technique roster, but he only trains players with Evil alignment (40 or lower). His '''Tournament''' option opens the Cell Games.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Cell Games ==
</translate>
{{Main|Cell Games}}
<translate>
The arena hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]], a bracket tournament with '''lethal''' bouts: losing a bout is a real death. Cell only talks to Evil-aligned players about it, as in his master dialogue.
</translate>

<translate>
== Protection ==
</translate>
<translate>
The arena is both a master's home and a tournament arena: ki attacks can't damage it, and survival or adventure players, explosions and mob griefing can't build in it or break it, unless the server changes the matching gamerules (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Cell Arena generates once per world, in a plains biome. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Cell Games Arena Map''' at trade tier 3, for 1 Tier-1 Radar Chip and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate cell_arena}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 20, ''The Cell Games'': find the Cell Arena.
</translate>
